# TMaps API Examples

> Live, client-side JavaScript examples for the TMaps APIs (maps, geocoding and routing with worldwide coverage and extra detail for Tunisia). Each example is a single HTML page using Leaflet, OpenLayers or MapLibre GL, and shows the exact API request it sends.

Key facts:
- API base URL: https://api.tmaps.tn ; tiles: https://tiles.tmaps.tn
- Authentication: `api_key` query parameter on every request (GET and POST). No Authorization header.
- Browser keys are restricted by authorized domains (Origin/Referer). No wildcard: add each subdomain and localhost. HTTP (non-HTTPS) requests are rejected with 403.
- Coordinates are WGS84 decimal degrees, `lat` / `lng`. Distances in meters, durations in seconds.
- Geocoding results give the point in `geometry.location` (`lat`, `lng`), a `formatted` address, a `confidence` score and `components`: street, commune, delegation, governorate, country.
- Routing: profiles `driving`, `walking`, `cycling`, `truck`, `scooter`; `language` `fr`, `ar` or `en` for instructions and street names; optional `departure_time` / `arrival_time` (local time, e.g. 2026-12-01T08:30); `avoid` `tolls`, `highways`, `ferries`, `unpaved`.
- Errors are JSON with standard HTTP codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 413, 429, 5xx). Routing and api_key errors use `{"error": {"code": "NO_ROUTE", "message": "..."}}`; geocoding uses `{"error": "..."}`.

## Display a map

- [01 Map with Leaflet](https://examples.tmaps.tn/01-raster-leaflet/): raster XYZ tiles `https://tiles.tmaps.tn/r-tile/{z}/{x}/{y}?api_key=…`, zoom 0 to 18.
- [02 Map with OpenLayers](https://examples.tmaps.tn/02-raster-openlayers/): same tiles with `ol.source.XYZ` and a shareable view in the URL.
- [03 Vector map styles with MapLibre GL](https://examples.tmaps.tn/03-vector-maplibre-styles/): styles `streets`, `dark`, `terrain`, `sunny` at `https://tiles.tmaps.tn/v-tile/{style}.json?api_key=…`.

## Find addresses and places

- [04 Address search (forward geocoding)](https://examples.tmaps.tn/04-geocoding-search/): `GET /geocoding/forward?q=…&country=TN&limit=5&proximity=lat,lng`. Returns `confidence` (0 to 1); save coordinates when ≥ 0.85.
- [05 Address from a map click (reverse geocoding)](https://examples.tmaps.tn/05-reverse-geocoding/): `GET /geocoding/reverse?lat=…&lng=…`. Returns the nearest address and its `distance` in meters.
- [08 Nearby places](https://examples.tmaps.tn/08-nearby-search/): `GET /geocoding/nearby?lat=…&lng=…&radius=…&categories=restaurant`. Radius up to 10,000 m, results sorted by distance.
- [13 Plus Code from a map click](https://examples.tmaps.tn/13-plus-code/): `GET /geocoding/pluscode?lat=…&lng=…&zoom=18` returns `{"plus_code": "8F8GR54J+JJ", "lat": …, "lng": …}`. `zoom` sets the length: ≤14 gives 8 digits (~275 m), ≤18 gives 10 digits (~14 m), >18 gives 11 digits (~3 m); 14 characters without `zoom`. Or `zoom`, `x`, `y` of a map tile for the code of the tile center.

## Routes and travel times

- [07 Directions](https://examples.tmaps.tn/07-directions/): `GET /routing/direction?from=lat,lng&to=lat,lng&profile=driving&geometry=geojson&steps=true&language=fr`. Returns `distance`, `duration`, `geometry`, `bbox` and `legs[].steps[]` (instruction, maneuver type/modifier, street name). `alternatives=true` for up to 2 other routes.
- [09 Delivery zone (isochrone)](https://examples.tmaps.tn/09-isochrone/): `POST /routing/isochrone` with `origin` and `contours` `[{ "time": 5 }, …]` or `{ "distance": km }`. GeoJSON FeatureCollection, one polygon per contour in request order; up to 4 contours, 60 min or 50 km.
- [10 Optimized delivery route](https://examples.tmaps.tn/10-optimized-route/): `POST /routing/optimized` with `origin`, `waypoints` (up to 50), `roundtrip` or `destination`, `optimize` `duration`/`distance`. `order` lists the waypoint indexes in visiting order.
- [11 Nearest driver (distance matrix)](https://examples.tmaps.tn/11-distance-matrix/): `POST /routing/matrix` with `origins` and `destinations` (up to 25 × 25). `durations[i][j]` in seconds, `distances[i][j]` in meters, `null` when no route.

## Complete use cases

- [12 Checkout address form](https://examples.tmaps.tn/12-checkout-address-form/): delivery address autocomplete with forward geocoding, auto-filled commune/delegation/governorate, and a draggable pin refined with reverse geocoding.
